selection.reason: no arm passes all of E1-E4
selection.rule: pass E1-E4; prefer A1u if its 2000-window $100k after-tax delta >= 70 % of A1's; else the eligible arm with the highest 2000-window $100k after-tax CAGR

gates.E1: median after-tax delta > 0 and share > 0 >= 60% over the 21 ETFs
gates.E2: delta > 0 in >= 70% of the 21 January starts and median delta > 0
gates.E3: seed 20261015, blocks (10, 40), 1000 paths: each run median delta >= 0 and share > 0 >= 55%
gates.E4: pre-tax clean bootstrap (seed 20261011, block 20) median delta >= -0.1 pp (base and calibrated) and main-window max DD <= C0 + 1.0 pp (base and calibrated)
gates.note: the E4 non-inferiority margin was chosen AFTER seeing v2's G5 result; v3's verdict rests on E1-E3 (new evidence). This is disclosed, not hidden.
gates.pass: E1 and E2 and E3 and E4
gates.selection: prefer A1u if its 2000-window $100k after-tax delta >= 70 % of A1's; else the eligible arm with the highest 2000-window $100k after-tax CAGR

params.instrument: synthetic QLD* daily-reset 2x on QQQ total return, expense 0.95%/yr, financing DTB3 + {base 0.0, calibrated 0.75%/yr}
params.signals: production R2 (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98
